links.comparator_used: Baseline GPT-5 without retrieval (training knowledge alone); OpenEvidence literature-anchored clinical AI also compared
links.outcome: Modified Generative Performance Score (mGPS; guideline concordance plus hallucination penalty) on 50 gynecologic oncology cases, scored by three gynecologic oncologists
links.effect: mGPS 0.83 (SD 0.26) for NCCN-anchored GPT-RAG vs 0.65 (SD 0.31) for baseline GPT-5 (W = 189.5, Z = -3.42, P < .001, r = 0.49) and 0.70 (SD 0.27) for OpenEvidence (W = 254.0, Z = -2.64, P = .008); mixed-effects OR 3.74 (95% CI 1.57-8.90) for GPT-RAG
links.quote: GPT-RAG exceeded baseline (W = 189.5, Z = -3.42, P < .001, r = 0.49) and OpenEvidence (W = 254.0, Z = -2.64, P = .008); OpenEvidence and baseline did not differ (P = .22).
